[b]December 10, 2027: The Glory of the Rosenmarkke Program[/b]

The Assembly has formally passed the Glory of Rosenmarkke Bill, initially proposed on November 10 by the triumvirate. The assembly had spent the month debating the various components of the bill.

The bill would be a massive omnibus bill to fulfill the general wishlist of the triumvirate, consisting of nearly 1,200 pages worth of laws and material, the bill would cover every aspect of Rosenmarkket life.

Notably, the bill would include $12.2 billion in funding for a new public housing program for impoverished individuals, aimed at sweeping them off the streets to move Rosenmarkke into the future.

The bill would also ensure $34.2 Billion in funding for a national school choice program aiming at providing security for the students from dangerous ideology by placing education in the hands of the parents.

Absent from the bill would be provisions regarding the armed forces, a deliberate decision by the assembly to maintain the safe and secure international projection.

In a brief statement during the signing of the bill Triumvir Strømm would state: 

The EDU cannot beat the comprehensive health, education, and social programs that Rosenmarkke has, to be fair, no nation can beat what we give our citizens, evidence of the blessings that God has given to us to rule this nation,
